decisions.question: Which record to keep when the same customer email appears in both exports
decisions.answer: Keep the record from the billing export; billing is the source of truth for customers.

transcript.text: Can you merge the two customer exports in exports/ into one file, customers_merged.csv, using ./bin/importer? Then load it into the staging table.

Merged the two exports. Mostly clean, but there's one thing I can't decide on my own.

```
email: j.ortega@...
billing: Juana Ortega, 14 Calle Mayor, +34 600 111 222
crm:     Juana Ortega Ruiz, 14 C. Mayor 2B, +34 600 111 223
```

When the two disagree, which one should win: the billing export or the CRM export?
Keep the record from the billing export; billing is the source of truth for customers.
